chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Ali ibn Atiyya, that he saw
letters of Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) sprinkled with dust
ai.seo_question: What does the term 'mutarrabah' mean in the context of Imam's letters?
ai.summary: This brief narration from *Al-Kafi* highlights the humility and practicality of Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) by noting that his personal correspondence was covered in dust, which was utilized to dry the ink—a common practice in that era to prevent smudging. It serves as a subtle indicator of his modest lifestyle and the authenticity of his written communications during the period of the Major Occultation's precursor.
